---
title: "General pepline for drawing heatmap plot in this study"
output: html_notebook
---
```{r}
library(pheatmap)
library(tibble)
library(readxl)

transcriptome <- read_excel("~/PMR/ZLY_Workspace/02. Workspace/03.Male or female/01.heatmap/MDP/2026.4 NEW/new key MD sperm.xlsx", 
    sheet = "【new MD sperm】-RPKM")
transcriptome <- as.data.frame(transcriptome)

transcriptome$...1 <- ave(
  transcriptome$...1,
  transcriptome$...1,
  FUN = function(x) {
    if (length(x) > 1) {
      x[-1] <- paste0(x[-1], "-", seq_along(x[-1]) + 1)
    }
    x
  }
)

transcriptome <- column_to_rownames(transcriptome, var = "...1")
data_matrix <- as.matrix(transcriptome)
data_matrix_log <- log10(data_matrix+1)
```
```{r}
annotation_col = data.frame(
  Sex = c(rep("Male",3),rep("Female",8)),
  Stage = c(rep("Virgin",4),rep("Post-maintg 6h", 1), rep("Post-maintg 12h",1),rep("Virgin",1), rep("Post-maintg 6h", 1), rep("Post-maintg 12h",1),rep("Virgin",2)),
 Organ = c(rep("Male",3),rep("FRT",3),rep("SP",3),rep("Negative control",2))
)
row.names(annotation_col) <- colnames(transcriptome)
```
```{r}
# 1. Raw heatmap
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
col_fun = colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2), c("#38639F", "white", "#DB5440"))

row_sd <- apply(data_matrix_log, 1, sd)
data_for_plot <- data_matrix_log[row_sd > 0, ]
cat("raw row number:", nrow(data_matrix_log), "\n")
cat("filtered row number:", nrow(data_for_plot), "\n")

pheatmap(
  data_for_plot,       
  cluster_rows = TRUE, 
  cluster_cols = FALSE, 
  col = col_fun,
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  border_color = NA,
  scale = "row",      
  show_rownames = FALSE,
  annotation_col = annotation_col, 
  treeheight_row = 0,
  cellwidth = 15, 
  cellheight = 0.5
)
```
```{r}
# 2. Heatmap with row scaled
data_scaled <- t(scale(t(data_for_plot)))
data_scaled[data_scaled < -2] <- -2
data_scaled[data_scaled > 2] <- 2

color_palette <- colorRampPalette(c("#38639F", "white", "#DB5440"))(100)
breaks <- seq(-2, 2, length.out = 101)  # 101 breaks for 100 colors

pheatmap(
  data_scaled,  # 使用手动标准化后的数据
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  color = color_palette,
  breaks = breaks,
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  show_rownames = FALSE,
  border_color = NA,
  annotation_col = annotation_col,
  treeheight_row = 0,
  cellwidth = 15,
  cellheight =0.5,
  use_raster=FALSE
)
```
```{r}
# 3. Heatmap with annotated key genes
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(grid)
library(circlize)

genes <- c("Act88F", "ATPsynCF6L", "ATPsynβL", "CaBP1", "CG9997", "Cnx99A", "Col4a1", "COX4L", "COX5BL", "COX6CL", "Cyt-c1L", "Cyt-c-d", "Jhbp5", "mt:ATPase6", "mt:CoII", "nmdyn-D7", "Ost48", "SdhAL", "SdhBL", "S-Lap1", "S-Lap3","Spn42De", "Swim", "tral")

idx <- which(rownames(data_scaled) %in% genes)
labels <- rownames(data_scaled)[idx]

ht <- Heatmap(
  data_scaled,
  name = "Expression",
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_row_names = FALSE,   # 关闭默认行名
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  top_annotation = HeatmapAnnotation(df = annotation_col),
  col = colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2), c("#38639F", "white", "#DB5440")),
  width = unit(ncol(data_scaled) * 5, "mm"),
  height = unit(nrow(data_scaled) * 0.25, "mm") 
)

ht + rowAnnotation(
  link = anno_mark(
    at = idx,
    labels = labels,
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize =9),
  )
)
```
```{r}
# 4. Drawing several heatmap plots for protein-protein interaction modules related to eusperm or parasperm
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(readxl)
library(grid)
library(tibble)

# 1. load in
df <- read_excel("~/PMR/ZLY_Workspace/02. Workspace/05.two_sperm/2026.5 NEW/2.heatmap/2026.06.11 NEW/List.xlsx")
df
```
```{r}
color_map <- colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2), c("#38639F", "white", "#DB5440"))

scale_rows <- function(m) {
  m_scaled <- t(scale(t(m)))
  m_scaled[is.na(m_scaled)] <- 0
  return(m_scaled)
}

# 2. annotation
# 2.1 Stage
stage_colors <- c("Virgin" = "#AA5440", "PM 6h" = "#385B6F", "PM 12h" = "#EBC855")
stage_vector <- c("Virgin", "PM 6h", "PM 12h", "Virgin", "PM 6h", "PM 12h")

top_anno_trans <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Stage = stage_vector,
  col = list(Stage = stage_colors),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE, 
  show_legend = FALSE,          
  simple_anno_size = unit(0.4, "cm") 
)

top_anno_prot <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Stage = stage_vector,
  col = list(Stage = stage_colors),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE,
  show_legend = FALSE,
  simple_anno_size = unit(0.4, "cm")
)

# 2.2 Note
all_note1_types <- na.omit(unique(df$Note1))
all_note2_types <- na.omit(unique(df$Note2))

global_note1_colors <- setNames(rainbow(length(all_note1_types)), all_note1_types)
global_note2_colors <- setNames(heat.colors(length(all_note2_types)), all_note2_types)

global_note1_bg <- setNames(rep("white", length(all_note1_types)), all_note1_types)
global_note2_bg <- setNames(rep("white", length(all_note2_types)), all_note2_types)

# 2.3 label
lgd_note1 <- Legend(
  title = "Note1 (Spermatheca/Eu)", 
  title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold"),
  labels = names(global_note1_colors), 
  type = "points", 
  pch = "\u25BA", 
  legend_gp = gpar(col = global_note1_colors),
  background = "white"  
)

lgd_note2 <- Legend(
  title = "Note2 (Detection)", 
  title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold"),
  labels = names(global_note2_colors), 
  type = "points", 
  pch = "\u25BA", 
  legend_gp = gpar(col = global_note2_colors),
  background = "white"
)

lgd_stage <- Legend(
  title = "Stage",
  title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold"),
  labels = names(stage_colors),
  legend_gp = gpar(fill = stage_colors),
  type = "grid" 
)

# 3. heatmap
# 3.1 get all GO term
all_gos <- na.omit(unique(df$`GO term`))
cell_side <- unit(0.5, "cm")

print(paste("Detected", length(all_gos), "unique GO term, starts painting"))

for (current_go in all_gos) {
  
  print(paste("Processing", current_go))
  
  sub_df <- df[df$`GO term` == current_go, ]
  sub_df <- column_to_rownames(sub_df, var = "...1")
  
  if(nrow(sub_df) == 0) next
  
  mat_trans <- as.matrix(sub_df[, 1:6])
  mat_prot  <- as.matrix(sub_df[, 7:12])
  
  if (is.character(mat_prot)) {
    mat_prot_num <- matrix(as.numeric(mat_prot), nrow = nrow(mat_prot))
    dimnames(mat_prot_num) <- dimnames(mat_prot)
    mat_prot <- mat_prot_num
  }
  
  trans_all_less_than_1 <- apply(mat_trans, 1, function(x) all(x < 1, na.rm = TRUE))
  
  mat_trans_scaled <- scale_rows(mat_trans)
  mat_prot_scaled  <- scale_rows(mat_prot)
  
  do_cluster <- nrow(sub_df) > 1
  
  left_annotation <- rowAnnotation(
    Note1 = anno_simple(
      sub_df$Note1, 
      pch = "\u25BA", 
      col = global_note1_bg[sub_df$Note1], 
      pt_gp = gpar(col = global_note1_colors[sub_df$Note1], cex = 1.0)
    ),
    Note2 = anno_simple(
      sub_df$Note2, 
      pch = "\u25BA", 
      col = global_note2_bg[sub_df$Note2], 
      pt_gp = gpar(col = global_note2_colors[sub_df$Note2], cex = 1.0)
    ),
    show_annotation_name = TRUE
  )
  
  ht_trans <- Heatmap(
    mat_trans_scaled,
    name = "Transcriptome\n(Z-score)",
    col = color_map,
    cluster_rows = do_cluster,     # 动态聚类开关
    cluster_columns = FALSE,       
    rect_gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 0.1), 
    width = ncol(mat_trans_scaled) * cell_side,
    height = nrow(mat_trans_scaled) * cell_side,
    row_dend_side = "left", 
    top_annotation = top_anno_trans,
    column_title = "Transcriptome",
    column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold"),
    show_column_names = FALSE,
    
    cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
      if (trans_all_less_than_1[i]) {
        grid.rect(x, y, width, height, gp = gpar(fill = "white", col = "black", lwd = 0.1))
      }
    }
  )
  
  ht_prot <- Heatmap(
    mat_prot_scaled,
    name = "Proteome\n(Z-score)",
    col = color_map,
    cluster_rows = do_cluster, 
    cluster_columns = FALSE,
    rect_gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 0.1), 
    na_col = "white", 
    width = ncol(mat_prot_scaled) * cell_side,
    height = nrow(mat_prot_scaled) * cell_side,
    top_annotation = top_anno_prot,
    column_title = "Proteome",
    column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold"),
    show_column_names = FALSE
  )
  
  ht_list <- left_annotation + ht_trans + ht_prot
  
  safe_go_name <- gsub("[/:*?\"<>| ]", "_", current_go)
  pdf_filename <- paste0("Heatmap_GO_", safe_go_name, ".pdf")
  
  pdf(pdf_filename, width = 12, height = 7) 
  
  draw(
    ht_list, 
    main_heatmap = "Transcriptome\n(Z-score)", # 以转录组为聚类主导
    column_title = paste(current_go),
    column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 16, fontface = "bold"),
    annotation_legend_list = list(lgd_stage, lgd_note1, lgd_note2),
    annotation_legend_side = "right"
  )
  
  dev.off()
}

print("All done.")
```
